GL-07.statement: A fresh non-seeded POC can assemble one customer-visible agreement from the exact current KEEP_FOR_CONTRACT proposals and the exact current validated A4 plan, preserving every retained planning record, declared provenance, and integrity binding without granting downstream authority.

GL-08.statement: Customer review binds exactly one contract ID, version, and confirmation fingerprint covering every customer-visible material field; only an acknowledged CONFIRM can continue the freeze path, while REQUEST_CHANGES is terminal for that version.

GL-09.statement: REQUEST_CHANGES consumes a materially changed newly current A3/A4 snapshot to create a complete immutable successor, preserving predecessor visibility and making the old link and confirmation unusable for the successor.

GL-10.statement: Freeze produces an immutable canonical contract only for the exact successor with a matching affirmative confirmation; the A5 path stops at freeze and does not execute, import evidence, issue an Evidence Pack, or calculate a verdict.

limitations: Storage is process-local, in-memory, non-durable, and not shared across workers.
The A5 execution policy is an explicit customer-visible freeze-only policy with no generated fixture, execution, evidence import, Evidence Pack, or verdict behavior; A6 owns those capabilities.
Reviewer and confirmer labels establish the recorded process-local decision boundary only; hosted identity assurance is outside Train A.
The browser proof uses fresh generated IDs and a fresh local POC; it stops after canonical freeze and makes no A6 call.
